messages:
jamie_sales: Quick thread— customer 'Aurea' wants a reserved GPU commit for production. Peak profile ~2.5k RPS chat, mix ~60% short (40 tokens) / 40% long (800 tokens). They want geo spread + documented fallback for legal.

ryan_se: Which model? Token mix matters a lot for GPU sizing and latency. Also need session stickiness expectations.

taylor_ml: They're planning a 13B distilled 4-bit as primary and 6B quantized for low-latency paths. Perf estimates: 13B ~0.9M tok/s per GPU, 6B ~1.6M tok/s.

devin_eng: Quick calc: avg tokens/request = 328 => ~820k tok/s at 2.5k RPS. Ideal GPUs ~0.9. Ops margin + KV cold hits => recommend reserve 3 GPUs baseline + 2 burst hot-spares across AZs.

infra_bot: Perf sim: reserve 3 + 2 burst, AZ spread AZ1:2 AZ2:2 AZ3:1. Expected p95 gen latency ~260ms with batching.

ryan_se: Sales needs a short contract line: "Reserved GPUs: 3 baseline, 2 burst credits; preheat 45m; SLA: 99.9% on provisioned capacity". Can we confirm cost delta vs pure burst?

jamie_sales: Also need graceful degradation order for legal.

taylor_ml: Degrade order: 1) route long responses to 6B; 2) apply truncation/stop tokens; 3) route non-critical to hosted multi-tenant in secondary region; 4) return failure envelope with retry-after if exhausted.

devin_eng: Implementation: add route selector tags (model_family, latency_class, session_compat). Soft-degrade timeout 400ms to protect tails. Preheat runbook: 45m window, synthetic ramp (20% -> 50% -> 80%), KV priming from customer top-500 prompts, smoke p95 checks, circuit-breaker on p99>1s.

kelly_security: Security blurb for questionnaire: "Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS (AWS/GCP/Azure), data plane encryption in transit & at rest, audit logs forwarded to customer SIEM, retention configurable; VPC peering and optional air-gapped on-prem package available."

jamie_sales: Actions: Ryan -> pricing comparison (reserve vs burst) by EOD; Devin -> PR for route policy + preheat checklist; Taylor -> upload perf numbers and fallback tests; Kelly -> paste KMS/logging text into questionnaire. Follow-up stand at 10:00 PT. :rocket:
